question: Which catalog pieces are printable at 80 and 130 mm tip to tip, and how do their finest features compare with the pieces already printed successfully?
hypothesis: Pieces whose closest zero-pole and pole-pole gaps at sea level are no smaller than those of the printed baseline pieces at 130 mm will print comparably; R4 on irregular inputs and high-degree R2 are the risks.
changed_factor: piece and size (display rule fixed per origin: baseline pieces use their own printed settings; new pieces use the order-tuned rule)
new_piece_display: order-tuned: complexplorer pole_order = max |order| of the reduced divisor, i.e. k = min(2 mu_max, 6)
